rationale: The assistant correctly identified E18 as a drainage code, advised unplugging first and pointed to the pump filter, which was the real cause, with no part recommended. Weaknesses: the second reply suggested resetting and starting a new cycle after the customer had already cleaned the filter, and told them to check the impeller, which they had already done. The final reply was brief and gave no advice on prevention (checking pockets, cleaning the filter regularly) or on when to call an engineer if E18 returns, and it did not mention mopping the wet floor or that the filter should be refitted securely to avoid leaks.
